statement: GlobalWafers said its 300mm, 200mm and 150mm lines are effectively at full utilization and that supply constraints have already appeared for certain advanced 12-inch products, citing AI chips, HBM, silicon photonics and advanced packaging as the demand drivers.
why: Wafers are the raw input for every AI chip, so a shortage at the substrate level puts a hard ceiling on how many accelerators and memory stacks can be built.

impact.mechanism: Full utilization and emerging constraints on advanced 300mm wafers cap upstream substrate availability, tightening supply for HBM, accelerators and advanced packaging alike.

evidence.excerpt: Our 12-inch (300mm), 8-inch (200mm) and 6-inch (150mm) production lines are effectively operating at full utilization
supply constraints have already appeared for certain advanced 12-inch products.

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet reporting direct quotes from an earnings call; no independent second publisher fetched, so confidence capped at medium.
